```python
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_HLTsel, get_nObj_min, get_nBtagMin

# HLT trigger selection for the semileptonic primary dataset, taken from parameters["HLT"]
trigger_sel = get_HLTsel(primaryDatasets=["semileptonic"])

# At least 4 jets in the "JetGood" collection with pT > 30 GeV
jets_sel = get_nObj_min(4, 30., coll="JetGood")

# At least 2 b-tagged jets ("BJetGood" collection, default working point)
btag_sel = get_nBtagMin(2, coll="BJetGood")

# Skim: loose selection applied directly on NanoAOD before object corrections
skim = [
    trigger_sel,
    jets_sel,
]

# Preselection: applied after object corrections/calibrations
preselections = [
    btag_sel,
]
```
